defs.def: as the representative of sb or instead of them 代表（或代替）某人

ex.s: It is my great pleasure to give a lecture here on behalf of the Be at One with Nature Association.
ex.t: 我很荣幸代表“与自然合一协会”在这里发表演讲。

ex.s: Mail - More Dear Mr Jenson, Iam writing on behalf of the school's Student Union.
ex.t: 邮件 - 更多 亲爱的詹森先生，我代表学校的学生会写信给您。

ex.s: Lam writing on behalf of the school's Student Union.
ex.t: 我代表学校的学生会写信。

ex.s: We need to speak out on their behalf before they disappear for good.
ex.t: 我们需要在它们永远消失之前为它们发声。

ex.s: Therefore, Cathy asked her friend Fiona to talk to Daisy on her behalf.
ex.t: 因此，凯西让她的朋友菲奥娜代表她跟黛西谈谈。

defs.def: in order to help sb 为帮助某人
because of sb; for sb 因为某人；为了某人
